# SofGent

> SofGent is an AI product studio. We scope, build and ship production-ready AI products — AI document automation, AI SaaS MVPs, and AI integrations — typically in 4–6 weeks for focused engagements.

Contact: contact@sofgent.com · https://www.sofgent.com/contact

## Services

- [AI Product Studio](https://www.sofgent.com/ai-product-studio): AI apps, internal tools and SaaS MVPs for founders, CTOs and operations teams.
- [Services overview](https://www.sofgent.com/services): AI product and MVP development, AI document automation, AI integration and automation.
- [OCR document automation](https://www.sofgent.com/services/document-intelligence-systems): Turn PDFs, forms, scans and attachments into structured, validated data.
- [AI SaaS MVP development](https://www.sofgent.com/product-development): From scoped idea to a live, monitored product.
- [Custom software](https://www.sofgent.com/custom-software): Workflow tools, internal platforms and integrations built around how a business already works.
